title: The Clock Taken Down and Dusted
youtube_title: The Clock Taken Down and Dusted | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Asking for a second pair of hands is a skill.
summary: At a cottage room with a long tablecloth and paper stars, a wall clock that needed one person to hold and one to wipe will go wrong if one person rushes. Eko and Una split it into two slow jobs, while the baker only offers a count or a name for the knot they need. They finish together.
